column1: # The reviewed fix table (WP-21): an analyzer fix is marked reviewed only when
# its tool, the tool's upstream version, its rule and its level match a row
# here whose state is `on`. The level the tool reports must equal the row's
# level: a project config that promotes a fix, a lying report or a version
# bump makes the fix unreviewed (it is still carried, never planned).
# Seeded 2026-10-21 from the safe fixes the pinned tools reported on the
# 21-repo public corpus. Owner defaults, switchable (set the state to `off`):
# useImportType, noTsIgnore and I001 are `on` (decision O-1, recommended).
# LX-CAR-1 (2026-10-23) added ShellCheck's three fixes the owner reviewed
# (Q-5: SC2006 safe; SC2086 and SC2164 only where the project's tests pass,
# which the server enforces) and the clang-tidy defect checks whose fix-its
# fix the defect; a fix-it that only restates the code (suspicious-string-
# compare's explicit `!= 0`) is a style change and is not listed (Q-6).
# SC2006 and SC2086 are below the precision budget and off (docs/collect.md,
# "Shell: ShellCheck"), so their fixes are carried only once a rule is on.
# clang-tidy fixes of checks not listed here are not carried at all; until
# DR-LOC-1, build-needing tools' fixes are planned MANUAL (D-LX-08).
# Columns: tool (catalogue name), version, rule, level, state (on | off), note.

owner Q-5: planned only when the project's tests pass. `|| exit` after cd: a failed cd stops the script instead of running on in the wrong directory
the condition tests the pointed-to bool instead of the pointer
erase gets the end iterator, so the whole removed range goes
strlen(s + 1) becomes strlen(s) + 1: the buffer grows to what is written into it; nothing else changes
the offset moves into the size: the allocation is large enough and the pointer is the one malloc returned
the error test compares with > 0, the only values the call reports errors with
memset gets the fill value and size it was meant to (0 for '0', arguments in order)
the stray semicolon goes, so the indented body is the statement's body again
